mapper.select: SELECT id, `level`, parent_code AS parentCode, area_code AS areaCode, zip_code AS zipCode, city_code AS cityCode, name, short_name AS shortName, merger_name AS mergerName, pinyin, lng, lat FROM region ORDER BY area_code

SELECT id, `level`, parent_code AS parentCode, area_code AS areaCode, zip_code AS zipCode, city_code AS cityCode, name, short_name AS shortName, merger_name AS mergerName, pinyin, lng, lat FROM region WHERE `level` = #{level} ORDER BY area_code

SELECT id, `level`, parent_code AS parentCode, area_code AS areaCode, zip_code AS zipCode, city_code AS cityCode, name, short_name AS shortName, merger_name AS mergerName, pinyin, lng, lat FROM region WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, `level`, parent_code AS parentCode, area_code AS areaCode, zip_code AS zipCode, city_code AS cityCode, name, short_name AS shortName, merger_name AS mergerName, pinyin, lng, lat FROM region WHERE area_code = #{areaCode}

SELECT id, `level`, parent_code AS parentCode, area_code AS areaCode, zip_code AS zipCode, city_code AS cityCode, name, short_name AS shortName, merger_name AS mergerName, pinyin, lng, lat FROM region WHERE CAST(area_code AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT(#{codePrefix}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN `level` = 2 THEN 0 WHEN `level` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, area_code LIMIT 1

SELECT id, `level`, parent_code AS parentCode, area_code AS areaCode, zip_code AS zipCode, city_code AS cityCode, name, short_name AS shortName, merger_name AS mergerName, pinyin, lng, lat FROM region WHERE parent_code = #{parentCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO region ( `level`, parent_code, area_code, zip_code, city_code, name, short_name, merger_name, pinyin, lng, lat ) VALUES ( #{level}, #{parentCode}, #{areaCode}, #{zipCode}, #{cityCode}, #{name}, #{shortName}, #{mergerName}, #{pinyin}, #{lng}, #{lat} )
mapper.update: UPDATE region SET `level` = #{level}, parent_code = #{parentCode}, area_code = #{areaCode}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, city_code = #{cityCode}, name = #{name}, short_name = #{shortName}, merger_name = #{mergerName}, pinyin = #{pinyin}, lng = #{lng}, lat = #{lat} WHERE id = #{id}
